I could not answer the PR question. The Falkon tools available to me can search the current code but not read commit history. I have no `list_commits`, `get_diff`, or equivalent, and the one attempt to call `list_commits` failed with "No such tool available." Without merge history I can't tell which PRs since 2026-04-16 added or removed a `voidedValue` line, or when each merged.

What I did establish is where `voidedValue` appears under `src` on the current default branch. The repository is `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib`. There are 61 matches across 10 files, and the non-test production code is:

- `src/utils/common-utils.ts`: the `voidedValue` default in the submission initializer (line 33), the `gracefullySetSubmission` parameter and its assignment (lines 38–46), and the check in `hasSubmission` (line 52). These are the most likely places for a PR to have touched the line.
- `src/processors/encounter/encounter-processor-helper.ts`: obs-building logic that reads `voidedValue` (lines 245–298 and 436–437).
- `src/types/schema.ts`: the `voidedValue?: any` field on the submission type (line 122).

The remaining matches are in test files: `src/utils/common-utils.test.ts`, `src/adapters/obs-adapter.test.ts`, `src/processors/encounter/encounter-payloads.golden.test.ts`, `src/processors/encounter/encounter-processor-helper.test.ts`, and a few others. A PR that changed only a test file would still count for the question.

To finish, I need either a Falkon tool that lists commits or PRs with their diffs (for example `list_commits` or `get_diff`, which the server instructions mention), or a local clone of `openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib`. With either, I can filter for merged main-line changes since 2026-04-16 that add or remove a `voidedValue` line under `src`.
